notes: Scan SET/RESET/cycle now use the reference nested voltage sweep, pre-read target check, post-pulse read and 10 consecutive confirmation reads. VCC/WL fields set ceilings. Both rails are limited to 3.0 V; RESET reference values above that are clipped/deduplicated. Each fresh job starts a fresh sweep; there is no automatic continuation of an interrupted job.

GUI scan cycle 80047979cb4b4d0b9c400f1271ba7b55 on r0/c0 completed with 300 captures. Initial read 37.725 uA. SET was already above 35 uA; all 10 confirmations passed (35.670 to 37.875 uA), so zero SET pulses. RESET delivered 96 pulses of 1.2 ms and ended at 16.725 uA, above the <=5 uA target. Maximum requested VCC 3.0 V and WL 2.88 V. No clipping. Read rails restored and CPU held. Current remains nominal/un-calibrated.

Scan cycle r0/c0 (job 03445201791b415ab509de0be846712d): 17.111 uA before SET, 47.844 uA after SET, 17.541 uA after RESET. SET 2.3 V/WL 1.3 V, RESET 3.0 V/WL 2.88 V, 1.2 ms. This is a reversible response, not a certified HRS/LRS target.
Corrected FPGA holds SE/TM low in WB and uses power mask 0x01CC (physical VCC_SET DAC2 off). With these corrections, read/SET/RESET/cycle all returned nonzero, column-31 TDC data through the GUI/API.

The deployed WB SET/RESET dispatch selects the permanent firmware issue_program_setup path: three setup words followed by two identical program packets without chip reset between them, then 15 tagged readbacks. The generic read-transport helper returned zero banks and was removed.

Final r0/c31 independent scan crosscheck: 42.245 uA before WB SET, 43.293 uA after WB SET, 43.070 uA after WB RESET. This test does not demonstrate a clear RESET resistance-state change. Earlier WB SET raised the same cell from 33.826 to 41.737 uA; neither run certifies HRS/LRS thresholds.

Final WB read/SET/RESET returned matching column-31 TDC words 0x0007D816, 0x0007D738, 0x0007D712 respectively. GUI WB cycle b10a8ce2fc334141952e77755f9b6798 completed read/SET/read/RESET/read, returning 0x0007D60E, 0x0007D743, 0x0007D72C, 0x0007D82D, 0x0007D81B. All five passed UART framing, command echo, full 15-word bank and matching-column checks.
Bias measurements from user: IREF 0.933 V, VCOMP 0.937 V, BIAS_COMP2 0.637 V, VBIAS 1.630 V, DC_BIAS 0.998 V in scan-idle profile. These are measurements, not live telemetry.
No FMC electrical properties or VADJ settings changed. Targets remain VDDA1 3.0 V and VCCD2 1.8 V.

Final read-only r0/c0 check returned 37.178 uA (job 8543a9799a37406180ed5c0757517ea7), compared with 18.067 uA earlier on this image (5b8cc7216e4547809f9de93806c86d71).
